name: Campfire SMS
description: Two-way SMS bridge for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build): the agent texts you when it finishes or is blocked and reads your SMS replies. Requires a per-installation bearer credential from your account; free demo, then paid. Install: `npx -y @campfiresms/setup` · [Docs](https://campfiresms.com/install.html)
